paragraphs: R' Yonah, father-in-law of R' Ami. Mentioned in Gittin, chapter 2, at the end of halakhah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ב ס״הא is read as chapter 2, end of halakhah 1 in the connected citation, without independent named-edition verification.
חמוה explicitly means father-in-law here. An earlier heading audit had חמריה; it is separate provenance, not a verified printed alternative. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
